title: Sold my Cervelo R5 Superbike for a  Lightcarbon LCR007 V rim brake bike

takeaways.text: He bought the frame used for about C$400; LightCarbon identified it and sold him a setback seatpost for US$120, but told him the LCR007-V is no longer made.
28 mm Continental GP5000 tires leave 4–5 mm of room on 21 mm-internal rims and he thinks 30 mm might fit, above the 25 mm commonly listed for the frame; no 30 mm test is shown.
With identical contact points he finds it far more comfortable than his previous-generation Cervélo R5 and no less fast; the bottom bracket has given no trouble.
His upgraded build (Ultegra rim brakes, power meter, carbon bar, wheels of about 1,350 g) weighed 6.2 kg with pedals fitted; the upgrades took its cost to about C$5,000.

disclosure: Owner video; he bought the frame used and later bought a seatpost from LightCarbon, with no sponsorship stated.
summary: A Canadian owner's rim-brake LCR007-V, bought used and built with Ultegra, compared with the Cervélo R5 it replaced.
